create_oracle23ai_client: create an Oracle23aiClient instance that initializes a connection pool and database schema for vector similarity search
insert_vector_items: insert a list of vector items with ids, text, vectors, and metadata into a named collection
upsert_vector_items: upsert vector items into a collection, updating existing items by id or inserting new ones
search_similar_vectors: search for similar vectors in a collection using cosine distance and return top-k results with ids, documents, distances, and metadata
query_items_by_metadata: query items in a collection filtered by metadata key-value pairs and return matching ids, documents, and metadata
